encodingDesc.p: The page image is authoritative. Hathi OCR and the 2014 XML are comparison witnesses only. Printed text is not silently corrected. Verse lines use numbered l elements. Citation hierarchy is author.work.fragment.line.

note.p: Pollux 10, 33 καλεῖται δὲ τὸ κλινίδιον καὶ κλιντήριον, ὡς ἐν Δὶς ναυαγῷ Ἀριστοφάνης ἔφη κτλ.

ὦ πονηρέ μ' — ὡσπερεὶ Bergk.] με ὦ πόνηρε — ὥσπερ. ἐξορίζεις] ἐκκορίζεις Bergkius recte. in verbo ἐκκορίζειν ludit, tamquam simul a κόρη et κόρις deducendum sit. 'cur virginitate me spolias, tamquam lectum cimicibus purges?' loquitur igitur puella. paullo aliter Thesm. 760. cf. Eupol. 233, 4. Menandr. ap. Schol.
